subject: CAIQ observation pack + evidence packaging plan
messages:
From: Samir Patel <security@clearlake.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ scope + trending observations request

Hannah —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. To move the CAIQ review forward, we need a compact package that maps Redwood's controls to the CSA CAIQ and provides one representative artifact per control (config, log sample, or owner attestation). Our audit team (cc'd below) is particularly focused on controls related to tenant isolation, key management, and telemetry retention.

Deliverables we need by COB next Wednesday (2026-11-04):
- CAIQ mapping table (CSV/XLSX) where each CAIQ question maps to Redwood control id + owner
- Evidence index (PDF) listing artifacts and short descriptions
- A small sample bundle (logs/configs) demonstrating the control in production (anonymized)

Can you confirm scope (tenant-dedicated vs hosted customers), and whether Redwood can produce a runtime trace sample for the telemetry controls? Also share the primary contact for evidence escalations.

Thanks,
Samir Patel
ClearLake Security
security@clearlake.com

On behalf of: Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@assuranta.com> (technical reviewer)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <security@clearlake.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope + trending observations request

Samir —

Appreciate the clarity and timeline. Summary / commitments:
- Scope: hosted API + Dedicated (we will mark tenant-specific evidence where applicable). We will NOT include on-prem packages in this bundle unless you request it explicitly.
- Deliverables: CAIQ mapping (XLSX), Evidence index (PDF), sample bundle (anonymized logs + configs).
- Evidence contact: Ben Carter (ben_carter@redwood.com) will be primary. Markus will lead runtime artifact extraction.

Proposed plan:
1) Today/Tomorrow — Internal evidence triage and owner calls (Markus/Ben/Hannah)
2) 11/02 — Ben sends draft evidence index + temporary S3 link to artifacts for review
3) 11/03 — We update the CAIQ mapping and bake in control owner comments
4) 11/04 COB — Package delivered to you with a walk-through slot (we can do 11/05 if needed)

If that works, Ben/Markus — please confirm the artifact list below and whether you can produce a 1-hour walkthrough for Priyanka.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust — Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope + trending observations request

Hannah / Ben —

I'll take ownership of gathering runtime artifacts and instrumentation proof points. Quick notes after a sync with infra:
- Tenant isolation: we can supply network policy manifests + sample tenant namespace export (anonymized) and a short justification note.
- Key management: encryption-config.yaml (KMS integration excerpt) + attestation from infra that CMK rotation schedule exists; we have a snapshot of the keystore ACLs (redacted).
- Telemetry retention/trace: we can produce a 72-hour trace sample (anonymized pids/ids) and a replayable snippet showing the retention policy enforcement.

I'll prepare the runtime-trace-samples.tar.gz (sanitized) and drop it on the S3 temp bucket referenced below. Ben — can you assemble the CAIQ mapping rows you own (dataflow, encryption, auth) into the spreadsheet? I'll add a "runtime artifacts" column to point to filenames.

Markus
Markus Klein
Sr. Infrastructure Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope + trending observations request

Hannah / Markus —

Attached: CAIQ-response-draft.xlsx (tabbed by domain) and a short evidence-index.pdf (summary). Attachment stubs below — full artifacts are on s3://redwood-trace-temp/CL-2026-0921/ (expires 2026-11-10):

Attachment stubs (in package):
- CAIQ-response-draft.xlsx (mapping table)
- evidence-index.pdf (short descriptions & control owner)
- runtime-trace-samples.tar.gz (sanitized traces for ATR-01, TELE-03)
- encryption-config.yaml (excerpt, shows KMS ARN + rotation policy)
- tenant-namespace-sample.json (anonymized network/tenant isolation export)

Sample evidence notes (short):
- CCM-EN-01 / CSA KMS-2: encryption-config.yaml (shows CMK binding + rotation policy). Owner: Markus Klein.
- CCM-TEL-04 / CSA TELE-3: runtime-trace-samples.tar.gz (sanitized traces) + evidence-index entry referencing logs/retention. Owner: Markus Klein.
- CCM-AUTH-02 / CSA A&A-5: auth-issuer-metadata.json + attestation from identity team. Owner: Ben Carter.

Ben
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
(attachment) CAIQ-response-draft.xlsx
(attachment) evidence-index.pdf

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <security@clearlake.com>, Priyanka Rao <pri.rao@assuranta.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: CAIQ observation pack delivered (temp link + next steps)

Samir / Priyanka —

Per our commitments, please find the initial CAIQ observation package for ClearLake attached and in the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_cdExAMPLElink

What we delivered:
- CAIQ-response-draft.xlsx — mapping table with control owners and short rationales (see tab "owner_comments").
- evidence-index.pdf — single-page index that lists each artifact, short description, and sensitivity classification.
- runtime-trace-samples.tar.gz — sanitized traces demonstrating telemetry retention + replay sample (s3 link provided to reviewers).
- encryption-config.yaml & tenant-namespace-sample.json — config-level artifacts for KMS and tenant isolation.

Immediate asks for your team:
1) Confirm receipt and whether the anonymization level is acceptable for the audit team.
2) Please flag any controls that need additional context or a longer artifact window (e.g., 90-day logs).
3) If Priyanka or the reviewer wants a walkthrough, we can schedule a 60-minute session on 11/05 or 11/08 — propose a time and we'll confirm.

Notes / constraints: The S3 temp bucket expires 2026-11-10. We can extend on request. Sensitive artifacts have redaction notes in the evidence-index.pdf.

Thanks for the collaboration — Ben and Markus were instrumental here. Internal follow-up: once the audit team confirms, we'll convert the mapping into the canonical CAIQ csv and archive the artifacts into our evidence vault.

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Trust — Redwood Inference
(attachment) evidence-index.pdf
